title.zh: Bitcoin Whipsaws as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion
title.en: Bitcoin Whipsaws as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion

current_state.zh: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.
